Enable it with one click, then test photo and video capture using the camera code you already have. It supports AVFoundation, UIImagePickerController, and common Flutter camera and image picker integrations. No SDK or project changes required. Includes a 7-day trial, a $5.99 lifetime license, and 10 free lifetime licenses for early Product Hunt testers.
